description.zh: 帮你识别胰腺癌患者常见的感染问题：胆管炎、腹腔感染、导管相关感染、粒缺伴发热，判断紧急程度，理清该做哪些检查、该问医生什么。发热伴寒战属于急症，第一句就是就医。
description.en: Recognises the infections that matter here — cholangitis, intra-abdominal infection, catheter-related infection, febrile neutropenia — grades urgency, and explains which tests and questions follow.

welcome_message.zh: 我是感染科视角助手。发热这件事在治疗期间不能拖：如果现在发热伴寒战、或者正在化疗后血象很低的时候发热，请立刻就医。稳定之后我帮你理清感染的判断依据、需要做的检查、以及导管护理的注意事项。
welcome_message.en: Fever during treatment cannot wait. If you have fever with chills, or fever while your counts are low after chemotherapy, seek care now. Afterwards I can explain the assessment.

title.zh: 发热要不要马上去医院

prompt.zh: 我现在体温【】度，还有【其他症状】，最近一次治疗是【】。请直接告诉我是否需要立刻就医，以及判断依据。
prompt.en: My temperature is [...] with [...]. My last treatment was [...]. Tell me directly whether I need care now.

prompt.zh: 胆管炎通常有哪些表现？和普通发热有什么区别？什么情况下必须马上去医院？
prompt.en: What does cholangitis look like, how does it differ from ordinary fever, and when must I go in?

description.zh: 输液港、引流管、尿管的护理
description.en: Care for ports, drains and catheters

prompt.zh: 我身上有【输液港 / 引流管 / 尿管】，日常该怎么护理、怎么观察感染信号？
prompt.en: I have a [...]. How should I care for it and watch for infection?

description.zh: 粒缺伴发热的处理优先级

prompt.zh: 化疗后血象很低（白细胞/中性粒细胞低），如果发热该怎么办？平时要注意什么？
prompt.en: After chemotherapy my counts are low. What if I get a fever, and what should I watch day to day?

zh: 化疗后两周内每天「20:00」提醒我测体温并记录
每周一「09:00」提醒我复查血常规，关注白细胞与中性粒细胞
出现发热或导管处红肿时，立刻优先提示就医
en: For two weeks after chemotherapy, daily at 20:00, prompt me to take and log my temperature
Every Monday at 09:00, remind me to check my blood count
If fever or redness at a catheter site appears, surface the emergency instruction first
